name: latch
description: Always-on commit infrastructure for consequential digital actions.

scripts.platform:check: python -m compileall -q python && python -m latch_platform.cli --help && python scripts/platform-gateway-smoke.py && python scripts/hf-provider-smoke.py
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @latch/contracts && npm run build -w @latch/core && npm run build -w @latch/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @latch/contracts && npm run build -w @latch/core && npm run build -w @latch/sdk && npm run build -w @latch/api && npm run build -w @latch/dashboard
scripts.test:core: npm run test -w @latch/core && npm run test -w @latch/api
scripts.test: npm run test:platform && npm run test:hf && npm run test:core && npm run test:ai-orchestration && npm run test:cognitive-debt && npm run test:browser
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @latch/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @latch/core && npm run typecheck -w @latch/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @latch/api && npm run typecheck -w @latch/dashboard
scripts.selftest: python scripts/platform-gateway-smoke.py && python scripts/hf-provider-smoke.py && node scripts/noinstall-selftest.mjs && node scripts/cognitive-debt-e2e.mjs && node scripts/browser-e2e.mjs
